{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = real_sales[
    (real_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (real_sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify number of loyal completed orders in real data
n_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print results
mean_revenue, n_loyal_completed"}
